title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 701 6th Street in Hawthorne, Nevada, as the "Sergeant Kenneth Eric Bostic Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 701 6th Street in Hawthorne, Nevada, as the "Sergeant Kenneth Eric Bostic Post Office."

summary.headline: A 2018 law renames the post office at 701 6th Street in Hawthorne, Nevada, after Sergeant Kenneth Eric Bostic.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the United States Postal Service facility at 701 6th Street in Hawthorne, Nevada, the "Sergeant Kenneth Eric Bostic Post Office." It changes only the name used for the building in federal records. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 21, 2018.
